_readme: The experience behind IT Surgery: enterprise projects from the founder's career, in plain English, no client names (sectors only, as on it-architect.uk). Shown in full on /about-us/; the first three on /business-it/.
intro: Our founder spent 25 years designing and securing IT for some of the world's largest organisations, and that is the standard we work to. A few examples, in plain terms:
outro: The same care goes into a slow laptop in Penarth as into any of those.
items: Kept a global energy company running while closing four data centres: 2,000 servers moved to new homes with no data lost.
Secured access for 65,000 staff at a global IT services group: who can log in, to what, and how it is checked.
Moved hundreds of servers into the cloud for an international airline group, with multi-factor sign-in on everything and the set-up automated so it could be rebuilt in hours, not weeks.
Protected a UK pensions provider's sensitive financial data during a move to the cloud, with zero data loss.
Built the IT for a brand-new joint-venture business from scratch: servers, storage, security, backups and 200 staff computers.
Set up offices in Kazakhstan, Nigeria and Algeria for energy companies, from the cabling to the login.
Global remote-working systems for 50-plus countries, so people could work securely from anywhere, years before it was normal.
